column1: # Black/Matrix AD - Chapter 4: Gomorrah's Case Against Sodom
# No manual wrapping: patchline.py supplies pixel-aware line breaks.

column2: Wait a moment, please!
All I had heard was that this city
was a wonderful city that values $$平等$$ and $$弱者$$...
That is the problem!
As you know, $$平等$$ and $$弱者$$ violate the $$七つの大罪$$.
Naturally, our city as well
has instituted conscription to prepare for the $$異端審問官$$s' imminent assault,
and organized a large vigilante force to protect our city!
But we are not professional fighters.
And the people of neighboring Sodom may report it to the $$異端審問会$$!
But the people of Sodom also said their city was built on $$平等$$!
That city is no good!!
The $$平等$$ they speak of is only for show.
In reality, only a small number of people with power live in comfort.
As a result, $$弱者$$ and elderly people who can no longer work are driven out of the city,
and I hear they live quietly in an abandoned village called $$ノア$$.
Can you truly call that $$平等$$?
And look at that black smoke!
Without any long-term plan,
they go on polluting nature, which ought to belong to us all!
And on top of that, they have developed new weapons and mean to destroy our city!!
I can't forgive that!!
But from what we have heard, we cannot simply accept this account as the whole truth!!
Then could you at least urge the people of Sodom not to turn against us?
If the $$救世主$$s tell them, perhaps... they will listen.
I... want to believe that.
Hmm...
This is terrible!!
The people of Sodom have advanced to near our city!!
What?!
